title: DiscoveryDiff
description: How one poll's knowledge bases changed since the last state it gave.

added.description: Each knowledge base the last state did not have.

updated.description: Each knowledge base the last state had at the same address, now otherwise.

removed.description: Each knowledge base the last state had, and this one does not.

duplicated.description: Each address, as host:port, that more than one of the state's knowledge bases is at. At most one of them is true: `added` and `removed` count each address once, and every one is in `state`.
